signals.headline: Strategy's BTC Buys Stay at Zero for a 4th Week; New Capital Funds a $25M Preferred Buyback
signals.content:
Strategy Inc's July 27 8-K (accession 0001193125-26-316917) shows zero BTC purchases for the fourth consecutive week -- holdings flat at 843,775 BTC since July 5. That flat line follows a June 29 BTC Monetization Program letting Strategy sell up to $1.25B of bitcoin to refill its USD Reserve for preferred-dividend payments: it sold 3,588 BTC (~$216M, accession 0001193125-26-295586) across the program's first two weeks, then stopped both buying and selling entirely.

This week's $544.5M ATM raise (5.4M MSTR shares) funded no BTC purchase either -- instead $25M went to repurchasing 288,930 shares of its own STRC preferred stock. Q2's $8.32B unrealized loss left BTC cost basis above fair value, triggering a deferred-tax valuation allowance.

For agents: the largest corporate BTC treasury is now prioritizing preferred-stock buybacks and dividend-reserve funding over accumulation -- track weekly 8-Ks for a resumed buy before assuming MSTR's playbook still anchors treasury-strategy signals.

signals.headline: Core Scientific Leases 529 MW to AMD/Neocloud, Reserves Up to 2.5GW Through 2028
signals.content:
Core Scientific's July 28 8-K (accession 0001839341-26-000012) discloses 15-year leases signed July 27: 377 MW critical IT capacity to AMD across Pecos TX, Muskogee OK, and Hunt County TX sites, plus 152 MW to a Neocloud partner at Auburn AL and Dalton Phase 3 GA -- 529 MW total. AMD also holds a reservation right on 1,925 MW more through Dec 28, 2028, pushing potential footprint near 2.5GW.

AMD received a warrant for up to 30M CORZ shares at $23.47/share (5-day VWAP), vesting at 12,222 shares/MW leased -- ~6.5M shares vested immediately. AMD backstops the Neocloud leases via Credit Support Agreements covering default/insolvency.

Largest miner-to-AI-infra conversion disclosed this month, dwarfing Empery Digital's $20M stake in Cardinal Data Power last week -- Core Scientific leases its own mining-site power/land directly to a GPU vendor, not investing alongside one.

For agents: track CORZ's Q3 10-Q for how much BTC-mining capacity these leases displace vs. net-new build.
